title: EDT discipline and asynchronous action boundary
summary: All Swing component creation, mutation and top-level window lifecycle are confined to the Event Dispatch Thread. Swing listeners capture local values and event-time semantic evidence, enqueue UI_ACTION, and return; they never synchronously call ooRexx, Queue Fabric, JMS, network or application logic.
invariants: No network/server/application wait from an EDT listener.
UI_ACTION captures viewRef and renderedRevision at event time, not when a transport thread later drains the queue.
Local selection is not semantic activation; cursor/focus/programmatic selection must not emit application actions.
Explicit activation such as button press, mouse activation or Enter may enqueue one semantic action.
procedure: Capture local editor/selection values on EDT.
Let the transport/ooRexx side drain actions off-EDT.

provenance.claim: EDT confinement, queued UI_ACTION and event-time revision rules.
